title: NASP as cover program for Aurora

tellings.quote: And Bill became convinced that NASP was actually a cover program for Aurora.

plain: A US project from the 1980s and 1990s to build a plane that could fly into space, known as NASP, is said to have really been a cover for a secret aircraft called Aurora. The writer Nick Cook tells this as the belief of a man named Bill Sweetman, saying "Bill became convinced that NASP was actually a cover program for Aurora." If so, the public project would have hidden a more advanced one.
